description: Na₂Ba₆V₂Sb₂O₁₇ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃/mmc space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra, and  a faceface with one BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 7°. There are three shorter (2.27 Å) and three longer (2.42 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent Ba sites. In the first Ba site, Ba is bonded in a distorted q6 geometry to nine O atoms. There are three shorter (2.92 Å) and six longer (3.01 Å) Ba-O bond lengths. In the second Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Ba-O bond lengths are 2.87 Å. In the third Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.64-3.06 Å. In the fourth Ba site, Ba is bonded to twelve O atoms to form BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with six equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and faces with six equivalent SbO₆ octahedra. There are six shorter (3.01 Å) and six longer (3.03 Å) Ba-O bond lengths. V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 20°. There is one shorter (1.73 Å) and three longer (1.75 Å) V-O bond lengths. Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, faces with three equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and  a faceface with one SbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 7°. There are three shorter (1.94 Å) and three longer (2.12 Å) Sb-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Ba and two equivalent Sb atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and face-sharing OBa₄Sb₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-60°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, three Ba, and one V atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Ba and one V atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na, four Ba, and one Sb atom.
